parameters.content:
## Path 1: form to first call (Vapi)
Form stands in for the Meta lead form. Light gate: valid US phone, consent ticked, no submission from the same phone in 24 hours. Outside 9:00 to 20:00 Pacific the lead is queued for the sweeper instead of dialed. Consent wording is a DRAFT until counsel signs off (task 1.4). Before any test call: attach the credential "Vapi API (outbound)" to both Vapi call nodes and fill the Vapi phone number ID in Call Settings and Retry Call Settings.

parameters.content:
## Path 2: Vapi end-of-call report
Set this production URL as the assistant server URL in Vapi (serverMessages: end-of-call-report). Header auth: credential "Vapi webhook secret" must match the secret on the Vapi assistant. Normalize Call Result reads Vapi message.call.metadata and message.artifact.structuredOutputs; confirm paths against one real payload.

## Path 3: retry sweeper
Every 5 minutes, 9:00 to 20:00 Pacific. Calls leads with NO_ANSWER whose nextAttemptAt has passed (5 minutes, 1 hour, next day; max 4 attempts, D-012). Opt-outs are excluded. The Retell version of this workflow (m2YJwZ1l8DTzyEkw) is untouched and stays the backup.

## Path 4: calendar lookup for Alex (Vapi tool check_availability)
Vapi calls this webhook during the call with optional preferred_date (YYYY-MM-DD) and time_of_day (morning/afternoon). It asks Cal.com for the next 14 days (Roof Inspection, event type 7404470, Los Angeles time) and returns exact times for the requested day, or the nearest days if that day is full, with spoken wording and the exact start time for booking. Uses credential "Cal.com Vapi" (Bearer). No header auth on this webhook: Vapi's tool request did not get past it (Oct 11), so the unguessable path is the secret; it only returns open times.
